healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify the Asana personal access token (or OAuth token) by calling GET /users/me, using the literal "me" the API accepts for the caller's own user. Takes no input and returns the connector health status with the authenticated user's gid, name, and email. This call also returns the caller's workspaces, useful for resolving the workspace gid Create Task and Create Project need.

tasks.create.title: Create Task
tasks.create.description: Create a task. name is always required. workspace is required unless projects or parent is supplied — Asana can infer the workspace from either. The response includes permalinkUrl only when opt_fields requests it; pass optFields to get it back.

workspace.description: Workspace gid. Required unless projects or parent is given.

projects.description: Project gids to add the task to.

parent.description: Parent task gid, which makes this a subtask.

assignee.description: Who to assign the task to: a user gid, an email address, or the literal string "me".

assigneeSection.description: Section gid the task lands in within the assignee's My Tasks list.

dueOn.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD. Use dueAt instead for a specific time.

followers.description: User gids or emails to add as followers.

completed.description: Create the task already marked complete.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include in the response, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.update.title: Update Task
tasks.update.description: Update a task. Omitted fields are left unchanged. To change project membership use Add Task to Section; this call does not accept a projects list.

assignee.description: Who to assign the task to: a user gid, an email address, or the literal string "me".

assigneeSection.description: Section gid the task lands in within the assignee's My Tasks list.

followers.description: User gids or emails to add as followers.

completed.description: Mark the task complete or incomplete.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include in the response, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.get.title: Get Task
tasks.get.description: Fetch a single task by gid. Pass optFields (e.g. "permalink_url,notes") to request fields the compact default response omits.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.listByProject.title: List Tasks by Project
tasks.listByProject.description: List the tasks in a project, ordered by priority within the project. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied, so this call always sends one. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

completedSince.description: Only tasks that are incomplete or were completed at or after this ISO 8601 time, or the literal "now" for only-incomplete.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.listSubtasks.title: List Subtasks
tasks.listSubtasks.description: List the direct subtasks of a task. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

projects.list.title: List Projects
projects.list.description: List projects, optionally scoped to a workspace. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

archived.description: Only archived (true) or only active (false) projects. Omit for both.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Fetch a single project by gid. Pass optFields (e.g. "permalink_url") to request fields the compact default response omits.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Create a project in a workspace. team is required when the workspace is an organization.

workspace.description: Workspace gid the project is created in.

team.description: Team gid. Required when the workspace is an organization.

public.description: Whether the project is public to the workspace or organization.

followers.description: User gids or emails to add as followers.

sections.list.title: List Sections
sections.list.description: List the sections of a project. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

sections.create.title: Create Section
sections.create.description: Create a section inside a project. Both the project and the section name are required.

projectGid.description: Project the section is created in.

insertBefore.description: Section gid to insert this section before.

insertAfter.description: Section gid to insert this section after.

sections.addTask.title: Add Task to Section
sections.addTask.description: Move a task into a section, removing it from the other sections of the same project. The task is inserted at the top of the section unless insertBefore or insertAfter is given. Asana answers this call with an empty object — there is no gid to read back, so the result echoes the section and task gids that were sent.

sectionGid.description: Section gid to add the task to.

task.description: Task gid to move into the section.

insertBefore.description: Task gid to insert this task before, within the section.

insertAfter.description: Task gid to insert this task after, within the section.

stories.listForTask.title: List Task Stories
stories.listForTask.description: List the story feed on a task — this includes both comments and system activity (field changes, assignments, and so on). Filter on resource_subtype == "comment_added" to get just the human comments. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

stories.create.title: Comment on Task
stories.create.description: Add a comment to a task, posted as a new story. text (or htmlText for rich text) is required.

isPinned.description: Pin the comment to the top of the task.

workspaces.list.title: List Workspaces
workspaces.list.description: List the workspaces and organizations the caller can access. Needed to resolve the workspace gid Create Task and Create Project require. limit must be sent and must be between 1 and 100 — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "is_organization".

tasks.delete.title: Delete Task
tasks.delete.description: Permanently delete a task. Asana answers this call with an empty object, so the result echoes the task gid that was sent. This cannot be undone.

tasks.search.title: Search Tasks
tasks.search.description: Search tasks in a workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspace}/tasks/search. workspace is required. This endpoint does not use Asana's offset pagination — it returns up to 100 compact tasks matching the filters. Premium workspaces only.

text.description: Full-text search across task name and description.

completed.description: Only completed (true) or only incomplete (false) tasks.

assignee.description: Maps to assignee.any: a user gid, an email, or the literal "me".

project.description: Maps to projects.any: a project gid.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "permalink_url".

tasks.addProject.title: Add Task to Project
tasks.addProject.description: Add a task to a project (or move it within a project) via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/addProject. Asana answers this call with an empty object, so the result echoes the task and project gids that were sent. Optional section, insertBefore, and insertAfter control placement.

project.description: Project gid to add the task to.

insertBefore.description: Task gid to insert this task before.

insertAfter.description: Task gid to insert this task after.

tasks.removeProject.title: Remove Task from Project
tasks.removeProject.description: Remove a task from a project via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/removeProject. The task is not deleted. Asana answers this call with an empty object, so the result echoes the task and project gids that were sent.

project.description: Project gid to remove the task from.

stories.get.title: Get Story
stories.get.description: Fetch a single story (comment or system activity) by gid. Pass optFields to request fields the compact default response omits.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "html_text".

users.me.title: Get Current User
users.me.description: Fetch the authenticated user via GET /users/me, using the literal "me" the API accepts for the caller's own user. Returns the user object including workspaces, useful for resolving gids other operations need.

users.list.title: List Users
users.list.description: List users in a workspace. workspace and limit are required — Asana only returns a next_page cursor when limit is supplied, and listing users without a workspace is not useful. Pass the opaque nextOffset from a previous call back as offset; it disappears from the result once the last page is reached. limit must be between 1 and 100.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

optFields.description: Comma-separated field list to include, e.g. "email".

workspace.description: Workspace gid the tag is created in.

limit.description: Results per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Defaults to 50.

offset.description: Opaque pagination token from a previous call's nextOffset. Omit for the first page.

attachments.create.description: Attach an external URL to a task via POST /attachments. This is a URL attachment (resource_subtype external), not a multipart file upload — file uploads are out of scope for the declarative template. taskGid and url are required. Optional name is shown in Asana.

taskGid.description: Task gid to attach to (maps to parent).

webhooks.list.title: List Webhooks
webhooks.list.description: List webhooks in a workspace via GET /webhooks. workspace is required. limit must be between 1 and 100.

resource.description: Optional resource gid to filter webhooks.

webhooks.create.title: Create Webhook
webhooks.create.description: Create a webhook via POST /webhooks. resource and target are required. This creates an Asana webhook subscription; it is separate from the connector event contracts.

target.description: HTTPS URL that receives webhook POSTs.

users.listFavorites.title: Get Favorites for User
users.listFavorites.description: List a user's favorites via GET /users/{userGid}/favorites. resource_type and workspace are required. Currently returns favorites for the authenticated user. limit must be between 1 and 100.

resourceType.description: Favorite type: portfolio, project, tag, task, user, or project_template.

workspaces.typeahead.title: Get Objects via Typeahead
workspaces.typeahead.description: Typeahead search in a workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceGid}/typeahead. resource_type is required. Results are compact and not paginated with next_page; use count (1-100) instead of limit.

resourceType.description: Singular type: actor, agent, custom_field, goal, project, project_template, portfolio, tag, task, team, or user.

query.description: Search string. An empty string still returns ranked results.

count.description: Number of results to return, from 1 to 100.

customTypes.list.title: Get Custom Types
customTypes.list.description: List custom types via GET /custom_types. Filter by project or workspace. limit must be between 1 and 100.

reactions.list.title: Get Reactions on Object
reactions.list.description: List reactions on an object via GET /reactions. target and emoji_base are required. limit must be between 1 and 100.

target.description: Object gid to fetch reactions from.

emojiBase.description: Emoji base character to filter reactions.

projectTemplates.list.title: Get Project Templates
projectTemplates.list.description: List project templates via GET /project_templates. Filter by workspace or team. limit must be between 1 and 100.

projectTemplates.listForTeam.title: Get Project Templates for Team
projectTemplates.listForTeam.description: List project templates for a team via GET /teams/{teamGid}/project_templates. limit must be between 1 and 100.

projectTemplates.get.title: Get Project Template
projectTemplates.get.description: Get a project template via GET /project_templates/{projectTemplateGid}.

projectTemplates.instantiate.title: Instantiate Project Template
projectTemplates.instantiate.description: Create a project from a template via POST /project_templates/{projectTemplateGid}/instantiateProject. Returns a job. name is required.

team.description: Team gid for the new project when the template lives in an organization.

privacySetting.description: Privacy setting: public_to_workspace, private_to_team, or private.

isStrict.description: If true, missing date variables return 422 instead of defaulting.

projectTemplates.delete.title: Delete Project Template
projectTemplates.delete.description: Delete a project template via DELETE /project_templates/{projectTemplateGid}.

taskTemplates.list.title: Get Task Templates
taskTemplates.list.description: List task templates via GET /task_templates. Filter by project. limit must be between 1 and 100.

project.description: Project gid to filter task templates.

taskTemplates.get.title: Get Task Template
taskTemplates.get.description: Get a task template via GET /task_templates/{taskTemplateGid}.

taskTemplates.instantiate.title: Instantiate Task Template
taskTemplates.instantiate.description: Create a task from a template via POST /task_templates/{taskTemplateGid}/instantiateTask. Returns a job.

name.description: Optional name for the new task.

project.description: Optional project gid to create the task in.

taskTemplates.delete.title: Delete Task Template
taskTemplates.delete.description: Delete a task template via DELETE /task_templates/{taskTemplateGid}.

projects.duplicate.title: Duplicate Project
projects.duplicate.description: Duplicate a project via POST /projects/{projectGid}/duplicate. Returns a job. name is required. include is a comma-separated list of optional elements such as members, notes, and task_subtasks.

include.description: Comma-separated optional elements to copy, such as members, notes, task_assignee, task_subtasks.

tasks.duplicate.title: Duplicate Task
tasks.duplicate.description: Duplicate a task via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/duplicate. Returns a job. include is a comma-separated list such as notes, assignee, subtasks, attachments, tags, followers, projects, dates, dependencies, parent.

batch.submit.title: Submit Parallel Requests
batch.submit.description: Submit parallel Asana REST requests via POST /batch. actions is an array of {method, relative_path, data, options} objects. Limited to 10 actions per call.

actions.description: Batch actions, each with method and relative_path (and optional data/options).

customFields.create.title: Create Custom Field
customFields.create.description: Create a workspace custom field via POST /custom_fields. workspace, name, and resource_subtype are required.

resourceSubtype.description: Field type: text, enum, multi_enum, number, date, people, or reference.

precision.description: Decimal places for number fields, 0 to 6.

enumOptions.description: Initial enum options for enum or multi_enum fields.

customFields.update.title: Update Custom Field
customFields.update.description: Update a custom field via PUT /custom_fields/{customFieldGid}.

precision.description: Decimal places for number fields, 0 to 6.

customFields.delete.title: Delete Custom Field
customFields.delete.description: Delete a custom field via DELETE /custom_fields/{customFieldGid}.

customFields.createEnumOption.title: Create Enum Option
customFields.createEnumOption.description: Create an enum option on a custom field via POST /custom_fields/{customFieldGid}/enum_options.

insertBefore.description: Existing enum option gid to insert before.

insertAfter.description: Existing enum option gid to insert after.

customFields.insertEnumOption.title: Reorder Enum Option
customFields.insertEnumOption.description: Move an enum option via POST /custom_fields/{customFieldGid}/enum_options/insert. before_enum_option and after_enum_option are mutually exclusive.

beforeEnumOption.description: Existing enum option gid to insert before.

afterEnumOption.description: Existing enum option gid to insert after.

enumOptions.update.title: Update Enum Option
enumOptions.update.description: Update an enum option via PUT /enum_options/{enumOptionGid}.

projects.addCustomFieldSetting.title: Add Custom Field Setting to Project
projects.addCustomFieldSetting.description: Associate a custom field with a project via POST /projects/{projectGid}/addCustomFieldSetting.

isImportant.description: Whether the field is important in this project.

insertBefore.description: Existing custom field setting gid to insert before.

insertAfter.description: Existing custom field setting gid to insert after.

projects.removeCustomFieldSetting.title: Remove Custom Field Setting from Project
projects.removeCustomFieldSetting.description: Remove a custom field from a project via POST /projects/{projectGid}/removeCustomFieldSetting.

allocations.list.title: Get Allocations
allocations.list.description: List allocations via GET /allocations. Filter by parent project, assignee, or workspace. limit must be between 1 and 100.

allocations.create.title: Create Allocation
allocations.create.description: Create an allocation via POST /allocations. start_date, end_date, and assignee are required. effort is {type: hours|percent, value: number}. parent is the project gid.

assignee.description: User or placeholder gid, or me.

parent.description: Project gid the allocation belongs to.

effort.description: Effort object with type (hours or percent) and numeric value.
Effort object with type (hours or percent) and numeric value.

timePeriods.list.title: Get Time Periods
timePeriods.list.description: List time periods via GET /time_periods. workspace is required. limit must be between 1 and 100.

timePeriods.get.title: Get Time Period
timePeriods.get.description: Get a time period via GET /time_periods/{timePeriodGid}.

timeTrackingEntries.list.title: Get Time Tracking Entries
timeTrackingEntries.list.description: List time tracking entries via GET /time_tracking_entries. Filter by task, project, portfolio, user, or workspace. limit must be between 1 and 100.

attributableTo.description: Project gid the time is attributable to.

timeTrackingEntries.listForTask.title: Get Time Tracking Entries for Task
timeTrackingEntries.listForTask.description: List time tracking entries for a task via GET /tasks/{taskGid}/time_tracking_entries. limit must be between 1 and 100.

timeTrackingEntries.createForTask.title: Create Time Tracking Entry
timeTrackingEntries.createForTask.description: Create a time tracking entry on a task via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/time_tracking_entries.

enteredOn.description: Day the entry is logged, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

attributableTo.description: Project gid the time is attributable to.

billableStatus.description: billable, nonBillable, or notApplicable. Requires Timesheets and Budgets.

description.description: Optional entry description. Requires Timesheets and Budgets.

timeTrackingEntries.get.title: Get Time Tracking Entry
timeTrackingEntries.get.description: Get a time tracking entry via GET /time_tracking_entries/{timeTrackingEntryGid}.

timeTrackingEntries.update.title: Update Time Tracking Entry
timeTrackingEntries.update.description: Update a time tracking entry via PUT /time_tracking_entries/{timeTrackingEntryGid}.

enteredOn.description: Day the entry is logged, YYYY-MM-DD.

attributableTo.description: Project gid the time is attributable to.

timeTrackingEntries.delete.title: Delete Time Tracking Entry
timeTrackingEntries.delete.description: Delete a time tracking entry via DELETE /time_tracking_entries/{timeTrackingEntryGid}.

rates.list.title: List Rates
rates.list.description: List rates via GET /rates. Filter by parent project or resource user. limit must be between 1 and 100.

rates.create.title: Create Rate
rates.create.description: Create a rate via POST /rates. parent, resource, and rate are required.

budgets.list.title: List Budgets
budgets.list.description: List budgets via GET /budgets. parent (project gid) is required. This endpoint is not offset-paginated.

budgets.create.title: Create Budget
budgets.create.description: Create a budget via POST /budgets. parent is the project gid. budget_type is cost or time.

tasks.addFollowers.title: Add Followers to Task
tasks.addFollowers.description: Add followers to a task via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/addFollowers.

tasks.removeFollowers.title: Remove Followers from Task
tasks.removeFollowers.description: Remove followers from a task via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/removeFollowers.

tasks.addTag.title: Add Tag to Task
tasks.addTag.description: Add an existing tag to a task via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/addTag. Tags cannot be added through Update Task.

tasks.removeTag.title: Remove Tag from Task
tasks.removeTag.description: Remove a tag from a task via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/removeTag.

tasks.createSubtask.title: Create Subtask
tasks.createSubtask.description: Create a subtask via POST /tasks/{taskGid}/subtasks. name is required.

completed.description: Whether the subtask is created completed.

defaultView.description: Default view such as list, board, calendar, or timeline.

projects.createForTeam.title: Create Project for Team
projects.createForTeam.description: Create a project in a team via POST /teams/{teamGid}/projects. name is required.

archived.description: Whether to create the project archived.

projects.createForWorkspace.title: Create Project for Workspace
projects.createForWorkspace.description: Create a project in a workspace via POST /workspaces/{workspaceGid}/projects. name is required. Organizations still need a team membership after creation.

team.description: Deprecated team gid; prefer memberships after creation.

projects.listForTask.title: Get Projects for Task
projects.listForTask.description: List projects a task belongs to via GET /tasks/{taskGid}/projects. limit must be between 1 and 100.

projects.getTaskCounts.title: Get Task Counts for Project
projects.getTaskCounts.description: Get task counts for a project via GET /projects/{projectGid}/task_counts.

projectBriefs.create.title: Create Project Brief
projectBriefs.create.description: Create a project brief via POST /projects/{projectGid}/project_briefs. Supply text or html_text, not both.

projectBriefs.get.title: Get Project Brief
projectBriefs.get.description: Get a project brief via GET /project_briefs/{projectBriefGid}.

projectBriefs.update.title: Update Project Brief
projectBriefs.update.description: Update a project brief via PUT /project_briefs/{projectBriefGid}. Supply text or html_text, not both.

projectBriefs.delete.title: Delete Project Brief
projectBriefs.delete.description: Delete a project brief via DELETE /project_briefs/{projectBriefGid}.

projectStatuses.list.title: Get Project Status Updates
projectStatuses.list.description: List deprecated project status updates via GET /projects/{projectGid}/project_statuses. Prefer status_updates for new integrations. limit must be between 1 and 100.

projectStatuses.create.title: Create Project Status Update
projectStatuses.create.description: Create a deprecated project status via POST /projects/{projectGid}/project_statuses. color is required. Prefer status_updates for new integrations.

color.description: Status color: green, yellow, red, blue, or complete.

projectStatuses.get.title: Get Project Status
projectStatuses.get.description: Get a deprecated project status via GET /project_statuses/{projectStatusGid}.

projectStatuses.delete.title: Delete Project Status
projectStatuses.delete.description: Delete a deprecated project status via DELETE /project_statuses/{projectStatusGid}.

projectMemberships.get.title: Get Project Membership
projectMemberships.get.description: Get a project membership via GET /project_memberships/{projectMembershipGid}.

projectMemberships.listForProject.title: Get Project Memberships
projectMemberships.listForProject.description: List project memberships via GET /projects/{projectGid}/project_memberships. limit must be between 1 and 100.

stories.update.title: Update Story
stories.update.description: Update a comment story via PUT /stories/{storyGid}. Only comment stories created by the authenticated user can be updated.

stories.delete.title: Delete Story
stories.delete.description: Delete a story via DELETE /stories/{storyGid}. Only comment stories created by the authenticated user can be deleted.

tags.listForWorkspace.title: Get Tags for Workspace
tags.listForWorkspace.description: List tags in a workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceGid}/tags. limit must be between 1 and 100.

teamMemberships.get.title: Get Team Membership
teamMemberships.get.description: Get a team membership via GET /team_memberships/{teamMembershipGid}.

teamMemberships.list.title: Get Team Memberships
teamMemberships.list.description: List team memberships via GET /team_memberships. Filter by team, or by user plus workspace. limit must be between 1 and 100.

user.description: User gid, email, or me. Requires workspace when set.

workspace.description: Workspace gid, required when filtering by user.

teamMemberships.listForTeam.title: Get Team Memberships for Team
teamMemberships.listForTeam.description: List memberships for a team via GET /teams/{teamGid}/team_memberships. limit must be between 1 and 100.

teamMemberships.listForUser.title: Get Team Memberships for User
teamMemberships.listForUser.description: List team memberships for a user via GET /users/{userGid}/team_memberships. workspace is required. limit must be between 1 and 100.

userTaskLists.get.title: Get User Task List
userTaskLists.get.description: Get a user task list via GET /user_task_lists/{userTaskListGid}.

userTaskLists.getForUser.title: Get User Task List for User
userTaskLists.getForUser.description: Get a user's task list in a workspace via GET /users/{userGid}/user_task_list. workspace is required.

users.listForTeam.title: Get Users for Team
users.listForTeam.description: List users in a team via GET /teams/{teamGid}/users. limit must be between 1 and 100.

users.listForWorkspace.title: Get Users in Workspace
users.listForWorkspace.description: List users in a workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceGid}/users. limit must be between 1 and 100.

users.getForWorkspace.title: Get User in Workspace
users.getForWorkspace.description: Get a user in a workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceGid}/users/{userGid}.

users.update.title: Update User
users.update.description: Update a user via PUT /users/{userGid}. Typically limited to the authenticated user.

users.updateForWorkspace.title: Update User for Workspace
users.updateForWorkspace.description: Update a user within a workspace via PUT /workspaces/{workspaceGid}/users/{userGid}.
